messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Amoxicillin can make birth control pills less effective. Ask your doctor about using a non-hormone method of birth control (such as a condom, diaphragm, or spermicide) to prevent pregnancy while taking this medicine. Take this medication for the full prescribed length of time. Your symptoms may improve before the infection is completely cleared. Amoxicillin will not treat a viral infection such as the common cold or flu. Do not share this medication with another person, even if they have the same symptoms you have.
Antibiotic medicines can cause diarrhea. This may happen while you are taking amoxicillin, or within a few months after you stop taking it. This may be a sign of a new infection. If you have diarrhea that is watery or bloody, stop taking this medicine and call your doctor. Do not use anti-diarrhea medicine unless your doctor tells you to.
Triplet: ["amoxicillin", "reduces effectiveness of", "birth control pills"]

The relation 'reduces effectiveness of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medication diminishes the intended effectiveness of the specified contraceptive method.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
B. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'has reduced plasma clearance in': The subject drug is cleared from the body at a lower rate in the specified population group.
D. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
E. 'should not be stored in': The subject drug should not be kept in the object entity, as this may lead to degradation or loss of efficacy.
F. None of the above.
